title: Rock, Paper, Scissors Roguelite
author: jkremer3
selftext:
https://kremer-git.itch.io/rock-paper-scissors-roguelite

Against the grain of all the high class graphical demos and one-shots, this is a small project where I set out to build a funny little parody of roguelites that was itself a fun to play roguelite on mobile or laptop. 

Proof that our monkey brains love RNG dopamine chasing.

Play rock, paper, scissors. Lose once and the run ends (unless you have extra lives). Stores appear periodically and you can buy upgrades across Rock (dumb and solid powers), Paper (powers related to the info you know) and Scissors (powers related to taking risks to earn more money).

Yes, I know there are at least one or two other rock paper scissors roguelites… but they didn’t match what I wanted it to be.
